title: FR: Support for Dexcom ONE
body:
xDrip doesn't support Dexcom One.
Attempting to start a sensor using the calibration code from the sensor results in an invalid code error.

Please enable xDrip to support Dexcom One.
https://www.dexcom.com/en-EE/shop/home?fbclid=IwAR3bnCRKoNkzpRHY_Qsqq-ES0FE3PZ6XBqYj0IuJZL0KFUr5TbhrNHxAZkw
